evals.name: reconnect-subscriber
evals.prompt: Implement a resilient Valkey Pub/Sub subscriber in Go that reconnects and resubscribes upon network drop.
evals.expected_output: A background subscriber loop with backoff retry, channel resubscription, and context cancellation.
assertions: Subscribes to channels and processes incoming messages.
Detects connection drop and reconnects with exponential backoff.
Automatically resubscribes to target channels after reconnecting.

evals.name: handle-slow-consumer
evals.prompt: A pub/sub subscriber receives messages faster than it can process them. Prevent memory blowup or dropped connections.
evals.expected_output: Using bounded channel buffering, worker pool, and metric tracking for dropped messages.
assertions: Buffers incoming messages with bounded internal channel.
Uses worker pool to process messages concurrently.
Emits warning telemetry and handles backpressure safely.

evals.name: publish-with-timeout
evals.prompt: Publish an event notification to a Valkey pub/sub channel with bounded context timeout.
assertions: Passes context with timeout to publish operation.
Handles network errors without crashing caller.
